ideas.pitch: An AI-powered wildfire and landslide risk assessment model tailored for Uttarakhand terrain, combining satellite data and weather forecasting to protect fragile mountain ecosystems.
ideas.title: HimalayanForestShield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Climate Action SDG while echoing winning patterns from regional sustainability hackathons like the Sacramento State AI Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A localized crop disease detection and soil health advisory platform using computer vision and lightweight ML models running on edge devices for farmers in rural Uttarakhand.
ideas.title: AgriSachet-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns tightly with SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and regional economic realities in Dehradun, prioritizing agricultural impact which judges heavily favor.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and machine learning-based water quality monitoring and leakage detection dashboard for smart hill cities, predicting contamination spikes before they hit municipal supplies.
ideas.title: JalSuraksha-WaterGrid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines IoT sensor simulation with predictive analytics, following the winning blueprint of the AquaSense IoT Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first multilingual learning copilot that translates regional Indian curricula into localized dialects and generates interactive quizzes for underprivileged schools.
ideas.title: EduBridge-OpenAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets Quality Education (SDG 4) with a strong local equity angle, highly appealing to academic judges at SRHU.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven waste segregation computer vision classifier combined with an optimized municipal collection route planner to tackle garbage management in tourist-heavy hill stations.
ideas.title: SmartBins-Hills
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning hardware-software integration seen at the TechnoMorph Hackathon with a direct, highly visible local municipal use case.
